review: A beautiful coastal route with warm water, charming blue-and-white streets, and a memorable stop in Bizerte's old port.
The desert landscapes were incredible, especially the sunrise near Ksar Ghilane and the quiet salt lake views around Chott el Jerid.
A relaxed way to discover Tunis, Hammamet, and Sousse. The medinas were full of character and the itinerary never felt rushed.
Dougga was the highlight of the trip. The Roman theater, hilltop views, and knowledgeable guide made Tunisia's history feel alive.
The archaeological sites were wonderfully preserved, and each day revealed another layer of Tunisia's Roman and Berber heritage.
The desert camp was peaceful and the night sky was unforgettable. A perfect trip for anyone who enjoys remote places and stargazing.
Watching the stars outside Douz was magical. The guides made the desert feel welcoming and the pace was easy to enjoy.
The sea views were excellent from start to finish, with a great mix of beaches, coastal walks, and historic harbors.
A peaceful hike through Tunisia's green northwest. El Feija and the mountain trails near Tabarka were both beautiful.
Tozeur was an excellent starting point for the Sahara. The oasis, salt lake, and desert scenery made every day feel different.
The desert route was full of variety, from Douz to the troglodyte homes of Matmata and the dramatic village of Chenini.
Tabarka was perfect for an active holiday. Diving, kayaking, and the coastal paths gave the trip a great sense of adventure.
The desert nights were wonderfully quiet, and the camp near Tembaine gave us a spectacular view of the stars.
The forests in the northwest were a refreshing surprise. The trails were scenic, peaceful, and well suited to a relaxed hike.
The Sahara itinerary was thoughtfully planned, with beautiful sunsets, welcoming local hosts, and plenty of time to explore.
Matmata and Chenini were fascinating. The underground homes and mountain landscapes made this one of our most memorable trips.
We loved discovering Tunis and the coastal medinas. The food, architecture, and friendly atmosphere made every stop special.
The ancient sites were the perfect combination of history and scenery. Dougga in particular was spectacular at sunset.
The heritage route was informative without feeling like a lecture. Bulla Regia's underground architecture was a real highlight.
The oasis scenery around Tozeur was beautiful, and the clear desert sky made the evening experience especially memorable.
The northern coast offered a great balance of outdoor activities and nature. Ichkeul was a peaceful way to finish the route.
The city tour was easy to follow and full of local color. We especially enjoyed the Medina of Tunis and the evening in Sousse.
The forest trails were cool and quiet, with lovely views around El Feija and plenty of opportunities to see local wildlife.
This coastal tour combined relaxing beaches with fascinating towns. The route from Hammamet to Bizerte was very well chosen.
The northwest forests were cool and peaceful, with easy trails and beautiful views around Ain Draham.
The medinas were lively and colorful, and the guide gave us excellent recommendations for food and small local shops.
The desert camp near Tembaine was comfortable and peaceful. Sunrise over the dunes was worth the early start.
A great introduction to Tunisia's desert parks, with wide landscapes, local traditions, and memorable stops in Matmata and Chenini.
The coast was ideal for an active holiday. Tabarka's water was clear, and the kayaking day on Bizerte Lagoon was excellent.
The forest route was calm and scenic from beginning to end. We especially enjoyed the fresh air around Ain Draham.
A fascinating journey through Dougga, Bulla Regia, and Thuburbo Majus. The ancient mosaics and ruins were beautifully presented.
The long desert route was demanding but rewarding, especially the sunrise at Jebil National Park and the quiet nights in camp.
The sports itinerary kept us active without becoming exhausting. Diving in Tabarka was the highlight of the whole trip.
The desert landscapes looked completely different each day, from the salt lake to the oasis and the dunes around Ksar Ghilane.
A wonderful route through Tunisia's historic sites. The Roman ruins at Dougga were impressive and the countryside was beautiful.
The desert stars were incredible, and the guide found a quiet spot away from all light pollution for a perfect evening.
The northern coast had everything we hoped for: clear water, rugged cliffs, and enough activities to keep every day interesting.
The forest landscapes were unexpectedly lush and the guide adjusted the walking pace perfectly for our group.
The coastal route was scenic and varied, with beautiful beaches, historic streets, and a lovely final stop in Bizerte.
The Sahara experience was well organized and full of unforgettable scenery. The local stories around the camp added a lot.
The desert villages gave the trip real character. Chenini's mountain setting and Matmata's homes were unforgettable.
A thrilling coastal adventure with excellent diving, scenic hikes, and a memorable visit to Ichkeul's wetlands.
The heritage stops were fascinating and the guide explained the history clearly. Thuburbo Majus was especially rewarding.
The northwest forests were peaceful and cool, with beautiful trails around El Feija and excellent views near Tabarka.
The Sahara route had a great rhythm, from the salt lake landscapes to the oasis camp and the dunes near Ksar Ghilane.
The desert parks were beautiful and surprisingly varied. The stops in Chenini and Jebil made the journey feel authentic.
The city route offered a wonderful mix of history and everyday Tunisian life. The medinas were our favorite part.
The coastal activities were exciting and well managed. Cap Serrat had some of the best views of the trip.
The desert skies were incredibly clear, and the quiet camp made it easy to slow down and enjoy the stars.
Dougga and Bulla Regia made this a fascinating cultural trip. There was plenty of history without too much time in the car.
The coastline was beautiful and the itinerary mixed swimming, walking, and historic ports very naturally.
A lovely hiking route through green hills and forests. Ain Draham was cool, quiet, and completely different from the south.
Matmata, Chenini, and Jebil each offered a different view of southern Tunisia. The route was adventurous and culturally rich.
The sports activities were varied and the northern coastline was spectacular. A great choice for an energetic holiday.
The night sky was breathtaking, especially from the camp near Tembaine. This was a peaceful and memorable desert escape.
A beautiful desert experience with comfortable camping, knowledgeable guides, and unforgettable views across southern Tunisia.
The archaeological sites were impressive, although the walking can be warm in the afternoon. Dougga was absolutely worth it.
The desert parks were spectacular and the local villages added depth to the experience. We loved the views around Chenini.
The forest route was well paced, with fresh mountain air, quiet trails, and a very welcoming local atmosphere.
The coastal activities were exciting and well organized, especially the kayaking and the views from Cap Serrat.
